feedback: Concept works physically and is buildable. Thermal model is sound: 1000kg pull-down ~25kWh (E1), wall gain ~216W for ~30m2 100mm PU at ~35K lift (E3) ~5kWh/day thermal, staged 250kg/day x4 days (E12) makes daily thermal ~11kWh -> ~4-6kWh electric at COP~2.5, consistent with 6.048kWh/day load (E16) and 1.48-day autonomy from 11.25kWh 48V 240Ah LiFePO4 (E13,E17,E21). 100kg ice =9.28kWh thermal (E23) = ~3.7kWh electric at COP2.5, adding ~0.6 day night shaving. PV 4kW tilted (E22 4.06kW required low-sun, E14 1.6kW fair-sun) with MPPT envelopes load; 20m2 array (E24) on separate vented canopy is credible and matches prior art SelfChill PV+MPPT+battery+DC vapour-compression+ice store architecture. Energy chain PV->MPPT->battery->cooler->room and ice->room is continuous, no conservation violation. Parts - cam-lock PU room, DC cooler, mono-Si PV, Victron-class MPPT, LiFePO4, racks/crates, steel canopy, wash slab - are purchasable and assemblable by panel assembly, steel erection, wiring, commissioning as listed. 50x 54L crates =2.71m3 (E5) at 20kg each =1000kg (E7,E20) is plausible bulk density. Remaining detailed design - wind uplift on canopy, door infiltration control, defrost/condensate, controls setpoints - is normal engineering, not a concept blocker.
